transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Hi there, S-Net customer support, Vicky speaking. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Vicky. I'm currently traveling in Italy on a business trip and my mobile data suddenly completely cut off with an alert saying I've reached my roaming data limit. I need urgent data access for navigation and business emails.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand how urgent it is to restore your mobile data while traveling abroad in Italy, Alexander. Let me check your roaming allowance and get you reconnected right away.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Vicky, I'm literally standing outside Milan central station trying to find my hotel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To locate your mobile account on my screen, Alexander, could you tell me your mobile phone number and your date of birth?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my mobile number is zero seven seven zero zero, nine zero zero five eight three, and my date of birth is the fourteenth of June, 1985.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Alexander. I have your mobile roaming profile open in front of me.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Great, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So just to confirm what has occurred: you are traveling abroad in Italy on business, and your mobile data has stopped working because you have reached your monthly European roaming data allowance, leaving you stranded without maps or email. Have I got that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly that. My plan comes with twelve gigabytes of EU roaming, and I must have used the last megabyte downloading presentation slides on the train this morning.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Checking your live roaming usage meter... yes, your billing cycle EU roaming consumption reached twelve thousand megabytes at eleven o'clock this morning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the system automatically block data once twelve gigabytes is reached?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, to protect customers from unexpected international data fees, our network automatically suspends roaming data until the next billing cycle or until a roaming booster is added.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I buy an immediate data add-on so I can get back online right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, we offer two EU Data Roamer bolt-ons: a five-gigabyte booster for ten pounds, or an unlimited EU roaming pass for twenty pounds valid for fourteen days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long will I be in Italy? I'm here for another six days, so the five-gigabyte booster for ten pounds is plenty.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The five-gigabyte booster activates immediately and remains valid until your return to the UK.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you charge the ten pounds to my next monthly direct debit bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the ten-pound one-off bolt-on fee will simply be added as a line item on your next standard invoice.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's very convenient, I don't have to read out credit card details in the middle of a busy train station.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please bear with me while I place you on a brief hold for about one minute while I provision the five-gigabyte EU roaming bundle and unblock your roaming data bar.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience while holding, Alexander. The five-gigabyte EU Roamer booster has been added and the network roaming block has been released.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Vicky. Do I need to restart my phone or will the data reconnect automatically?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Toggle Airplane Mode on for ten seconds and then turn it off so your device re-authenticates with the Italian partner network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Toggling Airplane Mode on... waiting ten seconds... toggling Airplane Mode back off... okay, the 5G icon just popped up next to the carrier name TIM Italy!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are you able to open your Google Maps application and load your hotel directions?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Opening Maps... yes! The full street map loaded instantly, and my email inbox is updating right now. What a massive relief!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms your mobile data session is fully active on the local partner network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does this booster also allow me to use personal hotspot to connect my work laptop?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, personal hotspot tethering is fully permitted within your five-gigabyte booster allowance.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will be essential for sending client reports from the hotel room tonight.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What about voice calls and SMS? Are calls back to the UK included in your plan while in Italy?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, all calls and text messages from Italy back to standard UK landlines and mobiles are included in your domestic monthly allowance with zero roaming surcharge.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's great so I can call my office in London without worrying about international rates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: If I travel across the border into Switzerland for a day trip, does the EU booster cover Swiss networks?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Switzerland is not part of the standard EU roaming zone, so data roaming in Switzerland incurs separate roaming charges or requires our Global Roam pass.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am very glad I asked, because I was considering visiting a client in Zurich on Friday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you do visit Switzerland, our Global Roam pass is five pounds per day and covers all Swiss networks.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will purchase the Global Roam pass if my Friday client meeting in Zurich is confirmed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And to prevent accidental background data usage in non-EU territories, your global spend cap remains safely set at zero pounds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That ensures my phone won't accidentally rack up huge charges if it connects to a Swiss cell tower near the border.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What should I do if my phone loses signal while traveling through railway tunnels in the Alps?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If signal drops, leaving network selection set to Automatic allows your device to seamlessly roam between TIM and Vodafone Italia depending on mast strength.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have network selection set to Automatic on my iPhone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That will guarantee optimal mobile coverage throughout your train journeys across northern Italy.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I monitor remaining booster data via the My S-Net mobile app while connected to cellular data?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the My S-Net mobile app widget functions internationally with zero roaming data consumption.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That makes tracking usage effortless.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the five-gigabyte booster expire at the end of the month or after thirty days?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The booster remains active for thirty full calendar days from the moment of activation today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That covers the rest of my trip with plenty of remaining time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you will receive a summary text message upon returning to the UK confirming your return to domestic allowances.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That makes transitioning back home seamless.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Would you like me to set up an SMS alert when your new five-gigabyte booster reaches eighty percent usage?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please, an eighty percent warning text will let me know if I need to top up again before the weekend.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have enabled automatic threshold notifications for your mobile line.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will keep me completely in control of data spending.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else regarding your roaming settings or mobile service that I can help with today, Alexander?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Vicky, you sorted out the data block in minutes and saved my business trip. Thank you so much!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net today, Alexander. Enjoy your stay in Italy and have a wonderful week.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks Vicky, take care. Goodbye!
